title: Best Webflow Alternatives: Cost to Stay, Cost to Leave
summary: Six Webflow alternatives priced at 1, 5 and 20 client sites, with what the code export really carries and what a seat costs the client who inherits the site.
body_markdown: Blink, and the reason is the shape of the bill rather than the sticker price. Twenty client sites cost **$6,588/yr** on Webflow — a $300/yr Premium Site plan per site plus a $588 Growth Workspace — and every person who edits one is a seat on top. Blink has no per-site plan and no seats at all: adding sites adds credits rather than site plans, and every plan includes unlimited workspace members at no per-person charge. Five sites' traffic is roughly 250 credits a month, which sits on a Business plan — priced from $40/mo at 100 credits up to 50,000 credits a month. We do not publish a five- or twenty-site figure because Blink's published ladder skips the rungs in between. The honest exception: if the twenty sites are near-identical brochures and someone enjoys running servers, self-hosted WordPress with one $199 Elementor Expert licence is cheaper at roughly $1,219 a year — before hosting reprices at renewal, and with the caveat that Elementor's own pricing page does not render, so that $199 is third-party-sourced and unconfirmed by Elementor.
